Noel Edmonds invites you to join a nationwide swap of news and views with the Stars, the Experts and the Collector of the Week. Swap of the Pops with Mike Love of The Beach Boys. Noel's Pick of the Pops and a chance to chat and swap with The Wurzels. News Swap with John Craven. All at Sea with the BBC.
Jen and Doug debate whether to just buy everything — yes, everything — at an estate sale. Also, Scott and Dale chase down a Plymouth muscle car.
When "Swap Shop" advertises a barn full of goodies — including a slew of old-timey spittoons — the collectors can't help but drool a little bit.
A vintage jacket from the '96 Olympics gets Leo and Danny's attention. Mark and Sammie Jr. nail down some antique American-made tools.
Sammie Jr. and Mark are thrilled to have a massive sale all to themselves — until Bobby and JD arrive. Scott and Dale search for the perfect pickup.
Sparks fly when Bobby and JD chase lightning rods. Also, Richard and Garin clash with a fellow comic collector, and Larry finds a pair of WWII boots.
Dale and Scott head over to an old racetrack in search of a bargain. Bobby and JD deal for Hot Wheels. Jen and Doug have a rough day picking.

Noel gets speed fever! The intrepid Mr Edmonds gets behind the wheel of one of the world's fastest racing cars and puts his foot down. Football crazy! Who will win the World Cup this year? Top TV commentator John Motson is around to answer your sporting questions. Have you got a Lucky Number? Noel could be dialling it today to pick your brains and give you a chance to win a super prize.

Join the Cheggers' Roadshow and see the world! (Or rather the British Isles.) This week Keith and his travelling team bring their package of fun and games from the top of a hill - but which one? Bill Owen, one of the stars of the smash-hit comedy series Last of the Summer Wine is around - so ring him this morning and meet the man behind the awful but lovable Compo. The Big Time girl is back!

The Cheggers Roadshow has a touch of oriental mystery - but it's not far from home and Keith could be round the corner from you! Lulu's back in town!! The girl from Glasgow is now an international star, but she's taking a morning off from her hectic schedule to sing a song and have a laugh. Is Richard Stilgoe the world's fastest songwriter? Give him a ring and put him to the test.

Meet a Superstar! The winner or this year's championship calls in this morning and reveals what it takes to win television's hottest sporting competition. Do you like everything you see on television or does some of it make you cross? Either way, why not let Barry Took know? Or you could send him a joke or funny story - Noel is giving prizes for the ones that make him laugh the most.

Can you draw? No? You will be able to by lunchtime. Tony Hart has some tips that will turn you into an instant artist. Ring him this morning, as well as a top pop star. Yes! Leo Sayer is back in town! There's music too from Duran Duran as well as loads of swaps and some good cartoons.

The Boomtown Rats are back! Bob Geldof sings live for Swap Shop and Johnnie is itching to get his fingers on the phone. Give them and Noel's guests a call. You could be live on air! Funny man Mike Harding is around for a laugh and a swap and there are more jokes too from Tom and Jerry. The Roadshow could go with a bang because BBC men Mat Irvine and Andy Lazell are joining Keith.

It's Lucky Numbers today and Barmy Barry Took is on hand with your jokes and Points of View. You can take a trip with Maggie to an American summer camp, hear the latest pop including music from Buzz, see your cartoon favourites and - if you would like call in, you can speak to Dee Hepburn, star of Gregory's Girl!

It's an All-Star Euroswap today! Go Channel-hopping to Belgium with Keith and Maggie and take a boat ride through the fabulous medieval city of Bruges. Among the people they're meeting is Belgian World Cup centre-forward Jan Ceulemans. Noel's invited Kevin Keegan in to chat to him - and you! Steve Davis is calling in with a super snooker swap and Adam Ant is back!

It's a party today as Swap Shop celebrates its 146th edition. There are cards, presents and entertainers. Barry Took is coming, so is B. A. Robertson. Richard Stilgoe is there and so is Bert. There are cartoons, the best in pop, and an end-of-season Stock Clearance that will amaze you. Don't miss it. Shop doors open at 9.30 am sharp, and close for the final time at 12.12 pm.
